name: B10-0499/2025 – Motion for a resolution
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the Commission delegated regulation of 3 November 2025 amending Delegated Regulation (EU) 2020/1818 as regards the definition of prohibited weapons
part_text:
The European Parliament is objecting to a change the European Commission wants to make to rules for climate-friendly investment funds. The Commission wants to narrow the list of weapons that such funds must avoid. The Parliament says this would let funds invest in companies making nuclear weapons, depleted uranium weapons, incendiary weapons, blinding lasers and killer robots. It asks the Commission to write a new version that keeps these weapons excluded.

- **What changes:** The Commission wants to swap "controversial weapons" for a shorter list of "prohibited weapons" in climate benchmark rules.
- **Who it affects:** Companies making weapons like nuclear arms, and investors in funds labelled as climate-friendly.
- **What happens next:** Parliament rejects the change and asks the Commission for a new version; the current one cannot enter into force.
